review.authority: User explicitly designated the current seated front master as the final authority and required the turnaround to follow it; Python source-pixel compositing was already authorized.
checks: Seated front is a uniform 0.359-scale copy of the unchanged canonical master, placed at (7,326).
Front item and standing-front cap use the same source cap pixels as the master, with uniform scales 0.83 and 269/435 respectively; crown, brim, badge and asymmetric leaves are not redrawn.
Side/rear columns were edited with the unchanged master as primary reference. Both side ears stay hidden, side leaves remain foreshortened and overlapping, and rear tilt/sprout orientation reverses.
Inspected complete sheet and enlarged crown/brim boundaries. Complete side/rear cells avoid masks cutting across silhouettes; blending occurs only in empty inter-column gray.
Static reference review only. Runtime idle/happy fit comparison is retained separately; final continuous motion observation remains pending.
limits: Hidden surfaces are generated interpretations, not surveyed geometry. Side views are not calibrated orthographic projections.
The generated sheet is an auxiliary view reference; source master determines fitted scale.

compositing.method: Direct master seated-front copy and front cap source pixels; complete generated side/rear columns, with 24px cosine blend only in empty inter-column gray.

identity_constraints: Rounded cream-white cap, navy band with one thin white stripe, short navy brim.
One central round navy badge with a cyan five-point star.
Two cyan leaves on a short stem are part of the CAP, not Luna anatomy.
The asymmetric sprout has its taller leaf on screen left in front and screen right in rear, consistently in standalone and fitted views.
Sprout rotates rigidly with the cap: left-side views foreshorten the leaf surfaces and show depth overlap; never reuse the frontal wide V silhouette in profile.

fit: The canonical_fitted seated front master is the final authority for cap shape and fitted scale. The original item sheet is its provenance; all turnaround and runtime variants must follow the master. No small-cap variant is supported.
Cap tilts down toward screen right in front. Preserve the opposite exposed ear tip and purple interior exactly as in the source master; do not expand the crown across that ear tip.
Front: anatomical-left ear is completely hidden. Rear: the corresponding screen-left ear is hidden and the tilt reverses.
Left-facing side/oblique views: both ears are occluded by the cap; no white tip or purple interior may protrude behind the crown.
Back shows cream crown and striped navy band, without duplicate brim or star badge.
occlusion: Front brim lies in front of forehead without obscuring eyes or expression.
No residual ear, forehead wedge or former cap pixels may remain beyond the corrected silhouette.
attachment_contract.transform: Follow skull translation and rotation at the source fitted head-relative scale. No independent floating, stretching or per-frame fitting to the canvas.
attachment_contract.character_invariants: Preserve base head/body ratio, silhouette and anchors. Tail starts at the same centered low rear-pelvis attachment in seated and standing poses, then curls to anatomical left (screen right in front, screen left in rear). Side views retain a narrower foreshortened hook and visible air gap from the back; do not flatten the curl onto the torso. Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs. Cap sprout belongs only to the equipment.
attachment_contract.edge_quality: Inspect final alpha over light and dark backgrounds at actual size and magnified boundaries. Clear hidden RGB and unintended disconnected pixels; preserve intentional confetti, props and anatomical gaps. Do not use coarse masks that cut through crown/brim curves.

generation_gate.on_missing_or_hash_mismatch: Stop generation and resolve missing/unreviewed references; do not invent a replacement.
generation_gate.pose_selection: Seated wheel-holding idle and empty-handed standing use the same fitted item geometry and skull attachment.
generation_gate.runtime_boundary: Reference-only files under art. No runtime resource replacement or automatic image-path loading is introduced.
